implementation.scope: One explicitly selected current real pharmaceutical/consumable SKU in hospital_inventory, 112..366 closed IANA business dates and three separately retained targets: requested, gross fulfilled, confirmed consumed. Recorded quantities are not latent demand.
implementation.comparison: 28 rolling origins, explicit H7 or H14, comparable full-origin errors only. WAPE/MASE with zero denominator remain undefined. Intermittent methods require at least two positive originals; zero, NULL, unit, missing days and stock constraints remain distinct.
implementation.parameters: Three explicit canonical fractions in (0,1], denominator <=1000. Exact rationals, no inferred unit conversion or stock-constrained demand imputation. Forecasts do not auto-create or select procurement.
implementation.governance: Current pharmacist signs original quantities; a separate current Super-admin reviews/publishes technical originals and complete series. Frozen private originals, member collection, public projection, current actor and signer roles are checked before execution and result acceptance.
implementation.outbound: Only typed public-source quantities and complete Prompt go to native process; private raw originals, author details, identity_secret, question and unrelated hospital/patient data do not.
implementation.storage: Four new tables; bounded MEDIUMTEXT originals and immutable complete-series/result blobs. Full private/public sources and results are size checked before persistence; exceeding limits fails rather than truncates.
implementation.acceptance_repair: After SQL flush, compare actual current AIRun task/lease/pointer/status/metadata to immutable pre-flush anchors, reload and recompute stored domain result, and verify the exact staged success-audit primary key. Recheck current Source/config/authority before commit; all writes roll back atomically on mismatch. Shared helper also covers existing Surgery.
implementation.known_scope_gap: No fitted clinical demand model, intervals, latent true demand, automatic ordering, external validation, hospital deployment or production enablement.

native_core.scope: Four supply cores and four owned test files; contract/math/native ASGI checks, not additional full-suite passes.
native_core.capacity_scope: Actual fresh-process 366 days / three targets / 4096-root typed source; denominator10 complete accepted, denominator997 exactly refused at deterministic work limit, no partial output. Individual maxima do not promise arbitrary combinations fit.
native_core.container_scope: 31 actual internal HTTP responses, nonroot, network none, read-only root, 512MiB limit; no hospital mounts, DB or remote model. Includes real slow chunked uploads and full host-side math comparison. Container-local HTTP is not a clinical deployment.

database.migration_scope: Actual private MySQL8.0.39: reconstruct actual 195-table legacy metadata and seed rows, stamp surgery_scenarios parent, then real two-migration upgrade/downgrade/upgrade. Does not claim a full empty-database historical migration chain. Old DDL/rows remain byte-identical; actual governed336-day series, 8MiB Unicode SQL and constraints checked.
database.legacy_scope: Actual private MySQL RR current-read lock probes: seven same-SKU competitors wait/timeout, User SHARE before SKU UPDATE, different SKU can proceed, role change blocked while holding current authority, full collection detects nonwinner changes. Function/SQL level, not JWT or whole worker on MySQL.
database.isolation: All database and native fixtures synthetic. Existing hospital DB/configuration/.env not accessed; task-owned private resources cleaned.

actual_governance_worker_pipeline.complete_scope: One actual controlled-clock synthetic case: 336 originals, actual JWT/ASGI queue and durable worker, native ASGI, full blob/result/frozen audit; H7 and H14 retained, no stock/purchase mutation. Not a remote model or extra full-suite result.
actual_governance_worker_pipeline.acceptance_targeted_result: 20 passed, 63 deselected in 88.27s; includes positive Supply/Surgery full pipelines and post-write fault injection. Not added to full count again.
actual_governance_worker_pipeline.independent_scope: Read-only external test demonstrated SQL audit trigger could erase task metadata after flush and previously still succeed; actual failed assertion retained, then permanent source tests and shared fix. No source edits during the proof.
actual_governance_worker_pipeline.precision_scope: Actual mounted app.main JWT/ASGI fixtures preserve .123456 UTC and literal clock strings through original full-hash responses. Original app serializer failure and final14 cases retained.
actual_governance_worker_pipeline.authority_scope: Independent actual private-MySQL probes first exposed old-role reads in an existing RR snapshot; shared actor/signer/audit helper now always locks current role even when populate_existing=False. These are function/SQL probes with explicit source bindings, not all HTTP/worker flows on MySQL.

frontend_build.fix_lineage: Retained failed budgets, reverted SWC experiment, actual Babel BigInt Math.pow crash and exact-string decimal repair. Shared API/chart/inline-asset reuse and DAG schema storage reduce duplication; no budget/target/dependency change. Concurrent product edits mean earlier size differences are not isolated savings benchmarks.

frontend_browser.scope: Exactly the previous 77 AI-scoped files plus 12 new files; 25 unrelated legacy business test files remain outside this explicitly unchanged AI-suite scope. Counts are actual single executions, never added targeted reruns. 180 real production UI cases and916 isolated cases replay synthetic APIs; only21 designated cases use real synthetic loopback HTTP.

Exact two substitutions only, same test titles and count, no guard or assertion removed.

targeted_frontend_evidence_not_added_aga.scope: 49 Series/Input,38 Source/API/schema,18 Provider,8 actual production entry and4 independent permanent cases are subsets of final1117; in-page guard leaves and actual fixture-export pytest reruns are not additional case counts.

None is presented as final green evidence.

artifact_retention: This tracked JSON includes final source maps and hashes of external evidence. Large raw synthetic packets, logs, report JSON and temporary runners remain local /tmp artifacts and are not bundled in Git or guaranteed permanent; no raw credentials or real hospital/patient data are committed.
limitations: No deployment, push, clinical/operational validation, remote inference or production enablement.

Recorded quantity baselines compare explicitly audited observations and fixed parameters; they do not establish latent demand, procurement optimality, causal effects or predictive accuracy at a real hospital.
Current private-MySQL proofs and synthetic SQLite/JWT/native pipeline checks have separately stated scopes; there is no claim that the complete HTTP/native worker chain was run on MySQL.
Source signatures, technical review and math consistency preserve provenance and declared unknowns; they do not establish clinical or operational truth.
